posts.author: Eric Logean
posts.content_md:
Hi,

I need to generate a 'phase' object. Something with thickness or refractive index variations in it. I will a 'transmission' hologram a carefully designed phase object. 

I will print my 2D object on a sheet of paper. Photoreduce it on a photographic black&white film. Develop and bleach it.

OK. I know how to develop but I would like to have some advice for the rest of the process:

- what is the safest and easiest to find chemical for the bleach?

- I am from Switzerland and I have just moved to Ireland. Where can I find the chemical, IE, UK suppliers?

- what do I do after the bleach? Wash, fix in a stop bath?

That's it.

posts.author: Colin Kaminski
posts.content_md:
A standard process would be develop, rinse, bleach, rinse, photoflo, squeegee and dry.

PFG-01 and JD-2 are easy to use.

You might try one of the Lab chemical suppliers:

[http://www.labpakchemicals.com/contacts.asp](http://www.labpakchemicals.com/contacts.asp)

Or you can contact Jeff Blyth:

[http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/profi ... ofile&u=56](http://holographyforum.org/phpBB2/profile.php?mode=viewprofile&u=56)

Some formulations are reprinted at:

[http://www.designerinlight.com/holo/chem.htm](http://www.designerinlight.com/holo/chem.htm)
